summary: Cybin Inc., operating as Helus Pharma, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 10, 2026, announcing that CEO Michael Halstead will participate in a fireside chat at the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference in New York on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. EDT, with a webcast replay available on the investor relations site. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. This is an ordinary conference-participation announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms, no risk-arb angle.
